rho_cdr_medage_2023.def: Spearman correlation across countries between crude death rate and median age, 2023 (the CDR now tracks age)
rho_cdr_medage_2023.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023

rho_index_le60.def: Convergent validity: Spearman correlation of the base index with life expectancy at 60 (not in the index; organizers' supplement), 2023
rho_index_le60.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023

rho_rank_7var_min.def: Smallest Spearman correlation between the rankings of the 7 index variants
rho_rank_7var_min.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023

share_rank_7var.def: Share of countries whose rank moves more than 20 places across the 7 hand-picked index variants of the v1 plan (z / min–max / ranks / dimension weights / PC1 weights / + net migration / geometric)
share_rank_7var.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023
share_rank_7var.sens_note: only normalization/aggregation variants (V1, V2, V3, V7) 1.2 · only weights (V1, V4, V5) 3.1 · adding net migration (V6 vs V1) 8.1 · all except the migration variant 3.7 · min Spearman between variants 0.970

share_rank_mc20.def: Share of countries whose 90 % rank interval (5th to 95th percentile of their ranks, R quantile type 7) is wider than 20 places across 2,000 random index designs (seed 2026): 5 indicators oriented so that higher = more advanced; Dirichlet(5) weights; normalization z / min–max / percentile rank and aggregation arithmetic / geometric, each drawn with equal probability; population growth included with probability 0.5; the geometric mean is taken on min–max scores (also when z is drawn) or on rank scores, floored at 0.01
share_rank_mc20.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023
share_rank_mc20.sens_note: Declared: Dirichlet(5) weights + normalization + aggregation + inclusion of growth 21.7 · Equal weights, only normalization and aggregation vary 2.5 · Dirichlet(5) weights, 5 indicators fixed 17.4 · Dirichlet(1) weights (very dispersed) + inclusion of growth 47.2

share_rank_mc20_sens.def: Share of countries with a 90 % rank interval > 20 places under each Monte Carlo specification
share_rank_mc20_sens.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023
share_rank_mc20_sens.sens_note: declared = Declared: Dirichlet(5) weights + normalization + aggregation + inclusion of growth · norm_only = Equal weights, only normalization and aggregation vary · dir5_fixed5 = Dirichlet(5) weights, 5 indicators fixed · dir1 = Dirichlet(1) weights (very dispersed) + inclusion of growth

twin_growth_are.def: Population growth rate, United Arab Emirates, 2023 (top pair of the twin rule |ΔTFR| ≤ 0.05)

twin_growth_blr.def: Population growth rate, Belarus, 2023 (top pair of the twin rule |ΔTFR| ≤ 0.05)

twin_tfr_are.def: Total fertility rate, United Arab Emirates, 2023 (top pair of the twin rule |ΔTFR| ≤ 0.05)

twin_tfr_blr.def: Total fertility rate, Belarus, 2023 (top pair of the twin rule |ΔTFR| ≤ 0.05)

twins.def: Top-5 twin pairs by rule: |ΔTFR| ≤ 0.05 and largest |Δ population growth rate|, 2023
twins.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023
twins.sens_note: chosen by rule from 12,880 pairs (≥ 1 M); illustration, no inference (family F3)

twins_lex_medage.filter: 161 countries ≥ 1 M people (2023); UN estimates for 2023
twins_lex_medage.sens_note: chosen by rule from 12,880 pairs (≥ 1 M); illustration (F3)
